profile.style: Flat hand-painted children's picture-book illustration, clean rounded outlines, matte colors, soft daylight. Consistent illustration style.

traits.color: bright orange fur, white cheeks, chest and tail tip, dark brown ear tips
traits.face: round head, short white oval muzzle, tiny black button nose
traits.clothing: one plain cobalt-blue scarf, simple knot and two short flat ends, solid unpatterned fabric
traits.proportions: short rounded body, head half the body height, small orange paws

traits.color: bright red cab, red rectangular tipper bed and flat red roof
traits.shape: compact boxy toy dump truck, pale blue windows
traits.parts: two round yellow headlights, grey grille with two horizontal bars, four black wheels with dark grey hubs
traits.scale: truck height one third of the fox height, blank smooth unmarked surfaces

profile.composition: Full fox from ear tips to paws and complete vehicle inside a generous 12 percent margin on every edge. Both on the ground in a compact central group. Forest surroundings, no foreground occlusion.
profile.exclusions: Only the listed character and vehicle. No duplicates, other animals, other vehicles, text, letters, names, logos, labels, symbols, watermarks, borders or collages. All surfaces blank.

scenes.action: On a forest path, the fox gently pushes the sole vehicle with its right paw, looking down at it happily. Both are fully visible.
On a forest path, the fox stands beside a tree and looks left with a searching expression. The sole vehicle rests on the right beside a low bush. The fox looks away from it. Both are fully visible.
